body:
No CI config exists (no .woodpecker.yml, no .github/workflows on the mirror).

A minimal pipeline running the existing release-checklist commands would mechanically catch regressions like T-151:
  python3 -m isort --check scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 -m black --check scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 -m pyflakes scripts/gittoc_lib/ scripts/tests/
  python3 -m pytest scripts/tests/test_gittoc.py

Key point: run on the MINIMUM supported Python version, not just latest. Optionally add `vermin` as a dev-only floor check.

Pure dev tooling, so the zero-runtime-deps stance is untouched. Labeled `human`: enabling Woodpecker on codeberg (or Actions on the GitHub mirror) needs repo-owner access. Depends on T-151 so the first pipeline run is green.
title: Add CI pipeline running lint and tests on minimum supported Python
